THREAT INTELLIGENCE SUMMARY
report.prepared: Automated summary, refreshed daily at 7:00 AM ET
report.sourceNote: Compiled automatically from CISA KEV, NVD, FIRST EPSS, Google Project Zero, ENISA EUVD, VulnCheck, Metasploit, Exploit-DB, PoC-in-GitHub and MITRE ATT&CK. Counts are catalog counts, not a count of cyber incidents; anything the sources do not establish is stated as not established.

blocks.text: CISA added **26 vulnerabilities** to the KEV catalog in November 2026 (month to date through November 23, 2026), spanning 23 vendors. CISA flags known ransomware use for 1 of them. The highest-likelihood additions by EPSS were **CVE-2026-123158 (OpenBSD OpenSSH)** and **CVE-2026-40217 (BerriAI LiteLLM)**.
These are CISA KEV catalog counts, not a count of total cyber incidents.

**Top five actions:** (1) Isolate or patch exposed OpenBSD OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158); (2) isolate or patch exposed BerriAI LiteLLM (CVE-2026-40217); (3) isolate or patch exposed Barracuda Networks Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) (CVE-2026-116606); (4) isolate or patch exposed Barracuda Networks Multiple Products (CVE-2026-111560); (5) examine OpenBSD OpenSSH hosts for unauthorized administrative access and configuration changes.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-123158 - OpenBSD OpenSSH authentication bypass (CVSS 8.1).** sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6p2 on Linux, when musl libc is used without PAM, lacks a workaround for a password authentication bypass (related to misinterpretation of whether a string is intended to be a password hash). For some configurations of accounts, any password between 256 and 1024 characters succeeds. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): openssh 10.6. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-40217 - BerriAI LiteLLM code injection (CVSS 8.8).** LiteLLM through 2026-04-08 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): litellm 1.83.10, ansible automation platform 2.6-9, openshift ai 3.3.4. Attack path: network-accessible; low-privileged authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-116606 - Barracuda Networks Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) authentication bypass (CVSS 9.3).** An authentication bypass in Barracuda Email Security Gateway versions earlier than 9.4.0.030 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): email security gateway 300 firmware 9.4.0.030, email security gateway 400 firmware 9.4.0.030, email security gateway 600 firmware 9.4.0.030, email security gateway 800 firmware 9.4.0.030. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.
KEV additions by week: week of Nov 2: 3; week of Nov 9: 12; week of Nov 16: 9; week of Nov 23: 2.
Known ransomware use (CISA): CVE-2024-10441 (Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM)).
No campaign-specific IP addresses, hashes or domains are collected by ThreatWatch's automated feeds. Victim counts and campaign scope are not established unless cited in section 5.

**Defensive hunting focus:** unexpected child processes and outbound connections (8 CVEs); unauthorized administrative access and configuration changes (8 CVEs); unusual requests and changes (6 CVEs).
